verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Al-ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo an sabeelillaahi adalla a'maalahum
Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa aamanoo bimaa nuzzila alaa muhammadin wa huwal-haqqu min rabbihim kaffara anhum sayyi'aatihim wa aslaha baalahum
Dhaalika bi-annal-ladheena kafaroo ittaba'ul-baatila wa annal-ladheena aamanoo ittaba'ul-haqqa min rabbihim kadhaalika yadribu Allaahu lin-naasi amthaalahum

Fa-idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo fadarbar-riqaabi hattaa idhaa athkhantumoohum fashuddul-wathaaqa fa-immaa mannan ba'du wa immaa fidaa'an hattaa tada'al-harbu awzaarahaa dhaalika wa law yashaa'u Allaahu laantasara minhum wa laakin liyabluwa ba'dakum biba'din wal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi falan yudilla a'maalahum
Sayahdeehim wa yuslihu baalahum
Wa yudkhiluhumul-jannata arrafahaa lahum
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tansuroo Allaaha yansurkum wa yuthabbit aqdaamakum
Wal-ladheena kafaroo fata'san lahum wa adalla a'maalahum
Dhaalika bi-annahum karihoo maa anzala Allaahu fa-ahbata a'maalahum
Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim dammara Allaahu alayhim wa lilkaafireena amthaaluhaa
Dhaalika bi-anna Allaaha mawlal-ladheena aamanoo wa annal-kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum
Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wal-ladheena kafaroo yatamatta'oona wa ya'kuloona kamaa ta'kulul-an'aam wan-naaru mathwan lahum
Wa ka'ayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatikal-latee akhrajatka ahlaknaahum falaa naasira lahum
Afaman kaana alaa bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu soo'u amalihi wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum

Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoona feehaa anhaarun min maa'in ghayri aasinin wa anhaarun min labanin lam yataghayyar ta'muhu wa anhaarun min khamrin ladhdhatin lish-shaaribeena wa anhaarun min asalin musaffan wa lahum feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wa maghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khaalidun fin-naari wa suqoo maa'an hameeman faqatta'a am'aa'ahum
Wa minhum man yastami'u ilayka hattaa idhaa kharajoo min indika qaaloo lilladheena ootul-ilma maadhaa qaala aanifan ulaa'ikal-ladheena taba'a Allaahu alaa quloobihim wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum
Wal-ladheena ihtadaw zaadahum hudan wa aataahum taqwhum
Fahal yanzuroona illas-saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa'a ashraatuhaa fa-annaa lahum idhaa jaa'athum dhikraahum
Fa'lam annahu laa ilaaha illaa Allaahu wastaghfir lidhanbika wa lilmu'mineena wal-mu'minaati Wallaahu ya'lamu mutaqallabakum wa mathwaakum

Wa yaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo lawlaa nuzzilat sooratun fa-idhaa unzilat sooratun muhkamatun wa dhukira feehal-qitaalu ra'aytal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun yanzuroona ilayka nazaral-maghshiyyi alayhi minal-mawti fa-awlaa lahum
Taa'atun wa qawlun ma'roofun fa-idhaa azamal-amru falaw sadaqoo Allaaha lakaana khayran lahum
Fahal asaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fil-ardi wa tuqatti'oo arhaamakum
Ulaa'ikal-ladheena la-anahumu Allaahu fa-asammahum wa a'maa absaarahum
Afalaa yatadabbaroonal-qur'aana am alaa quloobin aqfaaluhaa
Innal-ladheena irtaddoo alaa adbaarihim min ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudash-shaytaanu sawwala lahum wa amlaa lahum
Dhaalika bi-annahum qaaloo lilladheena karihoo maa nazzala Allaahu sanutee'ukum fee ba'dil-amri Wallaahu ya'lamu israarahum
Fakayfa idhaa tawaffathumul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa adbaarahum
Dhaalika bi-annahumu ittaba'oo maa askhata Allaaha wa karihoo ridwaanahu fa-ahbata a'maalahum
Am hasibal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allaahu adghaanahum
Wa law nashaa'u la-araynaakahum fala'araftahum biseemaahum wa lata'rifannahum fee lahnil-qawli Wallaahu ya'lamu a'maalakum
Wa lanabluwannakum hattaa na'lamal-mujaahideena minkum was-saabireena wa nabluwa akhbaarakum
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo an sabeelillaahi wa shaaqqur-rasoola min ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudaa lan yadurroo Allaaha shay'an wa sayuhbitu a'maalahum
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'oo Allaaha wa atee'ur-rasoola wa laa tubtiloo a'maalakum
Innal-ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo an sabeelillaahi thumma maatoo wa hum kuffaarun falan yaghfira Allaahu lahum
Falaa tahinoo wa tad'oo ilas-salmi wa antumul-a'lawna Wallaahu ma'akum wa lan yatirakum a'maalakum
Innamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la-ibun wa lahwun wa in tu'minoo wa tattaqoo yu'tikum ujoorakum wa laa yas'alkum amwaalakum
In yas'alkumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wa yukhrij adghaanakum

Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i tud'awna litunfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi faminkum man yabkhalu wa man yabkhal fa-innamaa yabkhalu an nafsihi Wallaahul-ghaniyyu wa antumul-fuqaraa'u wa in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonoo amthaalakum
